unit_cn: Unit 4 Body Language 肢体语言
source: 人教版2019选择性必修一 Unit 4 词表(真词,跳过专有名词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、肢体语言/手势/面部表情/跨文化非语言沟通主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: We can learn a lot by reading other people's body language.
words.example_cn: 通过解读他人的肢体语言,我们能了解很多。

words.example_en: A wave of the hand is a common gesture for saying goodbye.
words.example_cn: 挥手是一种常见的表示再见的手势。

words.meaning_cn: 不涉及言语的;非言语的
words.example_en: Most nonverbal messages are sent through our face and hands.
words.example_cn: 大多数非言语信息通过我们的面部和双手传递。

words.example_en: Body language plays a big part in our daily interaction with others.
words.example_cn: 肢体语言在我们与他人的日常交流中作用很大。

words.example_en: People from different cultures may interpret the same gesture in different ways.
words.example_cn: 不同文化的人可能会以不同方式理解同一个手势。

words.example_en: In Japan, looking down can demonstrate respect to an older person.
words.example_cn: 在日本,低头看可以向长者表达尊重。

words.example_en: A warm hug is a clear demonstration of friendship in many cultures.
words.example_cn: 在许多文化中,热情的拥抱是友谊的明确表露。

words.example_en: The gestures for "yes" and "no" differ around the world.
words.example_cn: 表示"是"和"不是"的手势在世界各地各不相同。

words.example_en: It is hard to distinguish a real smile from a fake one.
words.example_cn: 很难把真笑和假笑区分开来。

words.example_en: A loud phone can easily distract students from the lesson.
words.example_cn: 响亮的手机声很容易使学生从课上分心。

words.example_en: A good teacher can perceive when students are bored or worried.
words.example_cn: 好老师能察觉到学生何时感到无聊或担忧。

words.example_en: Your face often reveals your true feelings before you speak.
words.example_cn: 在你开口之前,你的脸常常已经显露了真实感受。

words.example_en: Crossing your arms may imply that you do not agree.
words.example_cn: 双臂交叉可能暗示你并不同意。

words.example_en: From her red eyes we could infer that she had been crying.
words.example_cn: 从她通红的眼睛我们能推断出她一直在哭。

words.example_en: We make inferences about feelings from people's body language.
words.example_cn: 我们根据人们的肢体语言对其感受作出推断。

words.example_en: Staring at someone too long can be interpreted as a threat.
words.example_cn: 盯着别人看太久可能被理解为一种威胁。

words.example_en: In some countries people bow from the waist when they meet.
words.example_cn: 在一些国家,人们见面时会从腰部鞠躬。

words.example_en: We bend our head forward as a sign of respect or shame.
words.example_cn: 我们把头向前低下,以示尊重或羞愧。

words.example_en: When we feel powerless, we tend to slump and make ourselves smaller.
words.example_cn: 当我们感到无力时,往往会垂头弯腰,让自己显得更小。

words.example_en: Holding a powerful pose for a while may make you feel stronger.
words.example_cn: 保持有力的姿势一会儿,可能会让你感觉更强大。

words.example_en: A good teacher knows how to react to students' body language.
words.example_cn: 好老师懂得如何对学生的肢体语言作出回应。

words.example_en: Some students hide their faces in their hands when they feel embarrassed.
words.example_cn: 有些学生感到尴尬时会用双手捂住脸。

words.example_en: A fake smile is often used to hide anger or worry.
words.example_cn: 假笑常被用来掩饰愤怒或担忧。

words.example_en: Body language can be a more reliable guide to feelings than words.
words.example_cn: 肢体语言可能比言语更能可靠地反映感受。

words.example_en: An identical gesture may carry a different meaning in another country.
words.example_cn: 相同的手势在另一个国家可能含义不同。

words.example_en: Our body language is shaped by our internal thoughts and feelings.
words.example_cn: 我们的肢体语言受内在想法和感受的影响。

words.example_en: Even a slight frown on her face can tell us she is unhappy.
words.example_cn: 她脸上哪怕一丝轻微的皱眉也能告诉我们她不开心。

words.example_en: Interested students often lean slightly forward towards the teacher.
words.example_cn: 感兴趣的学生常常稍微向老师前倾。

words.example_en: Some students cross their arms merely because they feel cold.
words.example_cn: 有些学生交叉双臂只不过是因为觉得冷。

words.example_en: Reading body language ultimately helps a teacher support every student.
words.example_cn: 解读肢体语言最终能帮助老师支持每一个学生。

words.example_en: Like spoken language, body language varies from culture to culture.
words.example_cn: 和口语一样,肢体语言因文化不同而各异。

words.example_en: People have a tendency to lean towards whatever interests them.
words.example_cn: 人们倾向于向任何让自己感兴趣的事物靠近。

words.example_en: Tone of voice, like body language, carries part of our message.
words.example_cn: 语气和肢体语言一样,承载着我们一部分信息。

words.example_en: Reacting to body language is an important component of teaching.
words.example_cn: 对肢体语言作出回应是教学的一个重要组成部分。

words.example_en: Some students occupy themselves by staring out of the window.
words.example_cn: 有些学生靠盯着窗外打发时间。

words.meaning_cn: 使更清晰易懂;阐明;澄清
words.example_en: We can ask questions to clarify any misunderstanding about a gesture.
words.example_cn: 我们可以提问来澄清关于某个手势的任何误解。

words.example_en: If a student looks upset, the teacher may inquire what is wrong.
words.example_cn: 如果学生看起来心烦,老师可能会询问出了什么事。

words.example_en: Body language tells a teacher when to intervene and offer help.
words.example_cn: 肢体语言会告诉老师何时介入并提供帮助。

words.example_en: Someone who employs the "OK" gesture in Japan may mean money.
words.example_cn: 在日本使用"OK"手势的人可能指的是钱。

words.example_en: In many places people favour shaking hands when they meet.
words.example_cn: 在许多地方,人们见面时更喜欢握手。

words.example_en: Someone who witnesses this gesture in France may read it as zero.
words.example_cn: 在法国看到这个手势的人可能把它理解为零。

words.example_en: In France and Russia friends may kiss each other on the cheek.
words.example_cn: 在法国和俄罗斯,朋友见面可能互相亲吻脸颊。

words.example_en: Worried students may have their arms crossed in front of their chests.
words.example_cn: 焦虑的学生可能双臂交叉抱在胸前。

words.example_en: With their chins on their hands, daydreamers stare out of the window.
words.example_cn: 下巴托在手上,爱做白日梦的人盯着窗外发呆。

words.example_en: Bowing from the waist is a polite greeting in many places.
words.example_cn: 从腰部鞠躬在许多地方是一种礼貌的问候。

words.example_en: If a student's eyes are red from weeping, deeper problems may exist.
words.example_cn: 如果学生的眼睛因哭泣而通红,可能存在更深的问题。

words.example_en: As an educator, I read my students' minds through their body language.
words.example_cn: 作为一名教育工作者,我通过学生的肢体语言读懂他们的心思。

words.example_en: He avoided eye contact; in other words, he felt nervous.
words.example_cn: 他回避眼神接触;换句话说,他感到紧张。

words.example_en: Some people make long eye contact; by contrast, others avoid it.
words.example_cn: 有些人会长时间对视;相比之下,另一些人则回避它。

words.example_en: A warm smile can break down barriers between strangers.
words.example_cn: 温暖的微笑能打破陌生人之间的隔阂。
